request.learning_goal: I want my fourth-grade students to explore force, motion, and engineering design through hands-on experiments.

recommendations.reasoning: The catapult activity directly connects hands-on experiments with force and motion: students vary the setup and can compare how those changes affect the ball's movement.
Designing and testing a marble track offers a way to investigate how track features relate to motion, with opportunities to reason from each test when refining the design.
Arranging a chain reaction with ramps, marbles, and connecting parts can support inquiry into motion and energy transfer, alongside collaborative engineering-style planning and testing.
